name: PiTensorProduct.map
type: {ι : Type u} → {R : Type v} → [CommSemiring R] → {s : ι → Type w} → [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (s i)] → [∀ i, Module R (s i)] → {t : ι → Type z} → [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (t i)] → [∀ i, Module R (t i)] → (∀ i, s i →ₗ[R] t i) → ((⨂[R] i, s i) →ₗ[R] (⨂[R] i, t i))
provides: The linear map induced on an indexed tensor product by one linear map on each factor; identity maps leave other factors unchanged.
